      "name": "mempool",

      "evidence": "Touches src/policy/policy.cpp and mempool tests only as a consequence of consensus rule enforcement.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The category definition explicitly excludes consensus validity; policy adjustments here merely follow from the consensus validation logic."
    },

      "name": "mining",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "name": "p2p",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No p2p relay, transport, or connection logic is modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Exposing deployment info through existing getblockchaininfo machinery is purely mechanical."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Extensive unit, fuzz, and functional tests are added specifically to pin BIP 54 consensus validation behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of a specific area belong to that area (validation) rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "This PR implements consensus cleanup rules resolving long-standing vulnerabilities such as quadratic sigops CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree collision (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp attacks. While not active on mainnet, bringing a complete, tested implementation upstream provides substantial strategic value for testing and evaluation across the project."
    },
